title: Batch Video Scraper
description: Bulk-scrape selected videos with field-level metadata blending strategies (merge, replace, overwrite, or fill empty).

blocks.text: Select multiple videos on the Videos list page and choose Scrape All from the bulk action bar to launch the Batch Video Scraper modal.

items: Choose the target Video Scraper from the dropdown.
Configure how each metadata field (Title, Date, Details, Cover, Studio, Performers, Tags, URLs) should be blended.
Set the request concurrency (1–4) to balance speed against site rate limits.
Click Start Batch Scrape to monitor live per-video progress.

rows: Populates the field only when the video does not already have a value
Replaces existing values with the newly scraped metadata
Appends new performers, tags, or URLs while keeping existing entries
